title: Retire the test launcher's own file-list run fingerprint in favour of the shared source_id
outcome: The launcher's run-input identity is only the `engram source` source_id compared before and after; its separate staged/unstaged/untracked fingerprint and .git/info rule images are gone
acceptance: The launcher no longer computes its own run fingerprint from `git ls-files` output, untracked listings or .git/info rule images; its before/after input check compares the whole source_id from `engram source`

A run whose source_id is equal before and after passes the input check, including one with local changes; a run whose source_id changes, including by adding a non-ignored untracked file, fails it; the separate new-untracked-only disposition is removed
Engram's and TermAl's launchers compare the same source_id object, with both coordinators' recorded concurrence
The launcher tests cover an unchanged clean run, an unchanged dirty run, an input change mid-run and an added untracked file
Repository instruction text that names the old fingerprint is updated under the governance rule for instruction changes

completion.summary: Delivered E2 increment 1: automatic launcher input validation compares the complete shared source_id, preserves actual stage facts, and treats new untracked input as an ordinary mismatch. Landed and installed fc749042; explicit review-freeze retirement is follow-up w-269eb2ad0179.
